Impeccable kindness, but I expected something more from the food.
Aug 2026 • Family
I will start with a definitely positive aspect: for the kindness, helpfulness, and professionalism of the waiters, I would have even given ten stars! They were truly impeccable and made the service very pleasant.

As for the food, however, I honestly expected something more, especially for a restaurant of this level. The presentation of the dishes was perfect and very well-cared-for, but some dishes did not particularly thrill me.

In particular, I found the salmon almost frozen, therefore not very appetizing. Overall, I expected something more, especially regarding the flavors.

An experience that was pleasant nonetheless thanks to the excellent service, but from a gastronomic point of view, I definitely expected more.

Best teppenyaki experience I’ve ever had!
Jul 2026 • Friends
Without question, one of the best dining experiences I’ve had not just in Hanoi , but actually anywhere.

We chose the Michelin starred teppanyaki experience, and from the moment we arrived, everything exceeded expectations. The restaurant itself is stunning, with elegant décor, beautiful lighting, and a calm, sophisticated atmosphere that immediately makes you feel you’re somewhere special.

The service was flawless. Every member of the team was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. They took the time to explain each course, the ingredients, and the preparation without ever making it feel rushed or scripted.

Our teppanyaki chef was fantastic. Not only was he highly skilled, but he was also incredibly friendly and engaging throughout the meal. Watching each course being prepared was part of the experience, and every dish was cooked to perfection.

The steak was among the best I’ve ever eaten anywhere. Every course showcased exceptional ingredients and precise execution.

One of the things that impressed me most was the flexibility and hospitality. The tasting menu we selected didn’t include fried rice, but the chef kindly prepared an incredible scallop and abalone fried rice from another menu. It was absolutely delicious and a wonderful surprise.

It’s rare to find a restaurant where the food, service, atmosphere, and overall experience all come together so perfectly, but this is one of those places.

Whenever I return to Hanoi, this will be the first restaurant I book. I couldn’t recommend it more highly.

Also just to mention I think they deserve an extra star at least, one star doesn’t justify what the restaurant has to give.

Amazing service and wagyu beef at Koki
May 2026 • Couples
We had an amazing experience at Koki! At first, we were skeptical because of the high price point. How is it possible that they charge this amount? Then, soon after we started the meal, it became clear. Everything was done impeccably. For the Yaeyama Kyori wagyu, we were presented with a proper certificate of its genealogy. Service was very attentive and warm. Our server Hai took good care of us. Our chef Tadano was also amazing; his cooking was not flashy but just masterful. The beef was beautifully done.

I highly recommend this restaurant, especially for special occasions!
